_comment: Evaluation protocols. Two results are numerically comparable only if protocol_id AND every key in comparability_keys match (aerolab.compare). metric_definition_version changes whenever the scoring code or a convention changes.

protocols.name: Single-target state accuracy (Anti-UAV Eq. 1), one-pass from the frame-0 GT box

metrics.mSA: mean over sequences of per-sequence SA (%); per frame: IoU if the target is visible, 1 for a correct 'absent' and 0 for a box when it is absent
metrics.precision_20px: % of visible frames with centre error <= 20 px
metrics.success_auc: mean success over IoU thresholds 0..1 (visible frames)
metrics.false_alarm_rate: share of absent frames on which a box is reported
metrics.located_rate: share of visible frames with a box

protocols.absent_frame_convention: absent frame scores 1 only if no box is reported, else 0 (Eq. 1); trackers that never report absence score 0 on every absent frame
protocols.failed_frame_convention: a visible frame without a box scores 0
protocols.init: frame-0 ground-truth box given to the tracker; scored frames = all frames from the start frame
protocols.implementation: experiments/anti_uav/src/anti_uav_repro/eval/metrics.py (sequence_metrics); equals the official CST toolkit per sequence (|d| = 0, tests/test_cst_protocol.py)

protocols.name: CST Anti-UAV official toolkit state accuracy (github.com/PCwenyue/CST-Anti-UAV @ bd92b984)
protocols.absent_frame_convention: as Eq. 1; the absence-neutral variant (absent frames scored 0 for every tracker) is reported separately in FINAL_REPORT.md section 3
protocols.failed_frame_convention: a visible frame without a box scores 0

protocols.name: Detector drone-class AP50 (conf 0.001, NMS IoU 0.7, max 30 det)
protocols.absent_frame_convention: images without a drone contribute false positives only

protocols.name: Track C trajectory forecasting (24-step ADE in px, Gaussian NLL), VAL

metrics.ade_px: average displacement error over valid future steps (px)

protocols.absent_frame_convention: future steps where the target is invisible are masked out
protocols.failed_frame_convention: anchors without enough visible history are skipped

protocols.name: Tracking quality HOTA / CLEAR-MOT / IDF1 (Track C re-implementation, cross-checked with TrackEval)
Deployment latency on the OMEN RTX 5050 (batch 1, p50 / p95 / p99 ms)
Studio smoke evaluation: Eq. 1 SA on the first N frames of selected VAL sequences

metrics.SA_partial: Eq. 1 SA over the scored (truncated) frames

protocols.init: frame-0 GT box; only the first max_frames frames are scored -> NOT comparable with full-sequence mSA

protocols.name: Frame-level target presence (TRAIN / VAL only): detector top drone score at a threshold, and the tracker's reported box

metrics.false_alarm_rate: absent frames classified present / absent frames
metrics.miss_rate: visible frames classified absent / visible frames
metrics.precision: present decisions on visible frames / all present decisions
metrics.presence_auc: ROC AUC of the top score, visible vs absent frames (Mann-Whitney)
metrics.correct_localisation_rate: visible frames classified present whose top box has IoU >= 0.5

protocols.init: frames after the start frame; the init frame is excluded

protocols.name: Controlled local speed benchmark (PyTorch eager, batch 1): warm-up frames discarded, CUDA-synchronised stage timing

metrics.median_ms: median end-to-end per-frame latency (read + preprocess + model + postprocess + tracker)
metrics.rss_mb: process resident memory after the run
